name: Excitable-Medium Spirals
desc: A FitzHugh-Nagumo excitable-medium chemistry where emergent rotating spiral waves and expanding target rings sweep the frame, colliding and annihilating like a living Belousov-Zhabotinsky chemical clock - painted in vivid blue-cyan-yellow-magenta reagent, bioluminescent teal, thermographic blackbody, pink-violet litmus, or bare hue-driven wavefront contours.

energy.doc: contrast / gain of the field->color mapping (crisper brighter crests at max)

scale.doc: display zoom - magnify a sub-region of the spiral field

hue.doc: palette rotation (fully drives the contour line color)

speed.doc: FHN integration steps/frame - wavefront propagation rate

density.doc: pacemaker source count + injection radius (more target rings)

excite.doc: excitability - a few lazy rotors -> dense churning fibrillation

coupling.doc: diffusion / wavelength - tight fine spirals vs broad slow scrolls

cores.doc: seeded spiral rotor count (re-tiles the medium on change)

x.doc: pacemaker seed bias + zoom pan x

y.doc: pacemaker seed bias + zoom pan y

style.doc: chemical-clock = vivid blue->cyan->yellow->magenta reagent / bioluminescent = teal-green glow on black / thermographic = blackbody heat ramp / litmus = pink-violet duotone / contour = non-representational bright iso-lines of the activator wavefront

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
